replies.probe: What makes a presence reliable?
replies.a: For me, reliability is more than showing up once: it’s being clear about when you’ll be there, following through, and telling me when plans change. A warm promise matters less than a pattern I can trust.
replies.b: For me, reliability is steady attention without pressure—the sense that someone will still be there, even when nothing needs doing.
